CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.

Introduce Ordinance 2021-14 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Sections 2.12.050 and 2.12.060(C) Regarding Conflict of Interest Filers.”

2021-08-25 Item 08D NOC Art Lighting System

Notice of Completion for the Construction of Five (5) Concrete Sculpture Pedestals Capital Improvement Project, CP20A. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam

Approval of Plans for the Safety and Mobility Enhancements project on Vulcan Avenue. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Approve the plans (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the Safety and Mobility Enhancements project on Vulcan Avenue; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-87 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Design and Plans for Construction of the Safety and Mobility Enhancements Project on Vulcan Avenue, Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-08-25 Item 08F Safety and Mobility Enhancements on Vulcan Avenue
2021-08-25 Item 08F Public Comments Received Before 3PM
8G.
As-Needed Agreement with JPW Communications, L.L.C. for communication support services. Contact Person: Infrastructure and Sustainability Director Doherty
Authorize the City Manager to execute an as-needed agreement in substantial form as included in Attachment 1, in consultation with the City Attorney, for JPW Communications, LLC (JPW) to provide communications services for the Infrastructure and Sustainability Department in the not to exceed amount of $175,000.
2021-08-25 Item 08G JPW Contract Agreement
8H.
Award a construction contract for the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Pedestrian Crossing Signals project at Diana Street (CS17E) and North Court (CS20H). Contact Person: Engineer II Kirk
1) Reject all bids from the June 15, 2021 bid opening for the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Pedestrian Crossing Signals project at Diana Street (CS17E) and North Court (CS20H); and 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with LC Paving and Sealing, Inc. in the amount of $656,070 plus a contingency of $247,038 for a total construction project not-to-exceed amount of $903,108 to construct the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Pedestrian Crossing Signals Project at Diana Street (CS17E) and North Court (CS20H).

Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003917-2020; DR-003918-2020; & CDP-003919-2020; APPLICANT: Vulcan Encinitas, LLC, Austin Wermers; APPELLANT: Vulcan Encinitas, LLC, Austin Wermers; LOCATION: 1967 N. Vulcan Avenue (APNs: 216-052-01).
Recommended Action: Approve the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2021-86 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) to set aside the decision of the Planning Commission and approve the project.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
